name: Generic DNS Tools
description: Protects against destructive or risky DNS tooling usage (nsupdate deletes, zone transfers).

destructive_patterns.name: stdin-unverified
destructive_patterns.description: nsupdate receives indirect input that the engine cannot statically verify.
destructive_patterns.explanation: Materialize and review the exact nsupdate commands before piping, redirecting, or loading them into the client.

destructive_patterns.name: dns-nsupdate-delete
destructive_patterns.description: nsupdate delete commands remove DNS records.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
nsupdate delete removes DNS records from the authoritative server using \ dynamic DNS updates (RFC 2136). Changes take effect immediately and can \ break services relying on those records.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - Test in a non-production zone first \ - Use 'prereq' commands to verify record state before delete \ - Keep backup of zone file or export current records

destructive_patterns.name: dns-nsupdate-local
destructive_patterns.description: nsupdate -l applies local updates which can modify DNS records.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
nsupdate -l uses local (loopback) TSIG authentication, allowing DNS \ modifications without network credentials. This is convenient for local \ testing but can accidentally modify production DNS if run on the wrong \ server.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - Verify you are on the intended server before running \ - Use explicit server and key options for clarity \ - Test changes with 'show' before 'send'

destructive_patterns.name: dns-dig-zone-transfer
destructive_patterns.description: dig AXFR/IXFR zone transfers can exfiltrate full zone data.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Zone transfers (AXFR/IXFR) download complete DNS zone data, revealing all \ hostnames, internal IPs, and infrastructure topology. This information aids \ reconnaissance for attacks. Most zones should restrict transfers to known \ secondary servers.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - Use standard dig queries for specific records \ - Request zone transfer permissions through proper channels \ - Check if zone transfer is authorized for your IP
